newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes softer in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes softer in moderate trade.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed weaker at C$1.3450 (US$0.7435) on Wednesday from Tuesday's close at C$1.3397 (US$0.7465) in moderate trading, dealers said.
* Traders said the unit's weakness was due to profit taking and a a softer U.S. dollar.
Market players took profits after Tuesday's rally, prompting the currency to sink, dealers said.
The Canadian currency also weakened after a sell-off in the U.S. dollar, traders said. The U.S. dollar recovered, but the Canadian currency continued to drag its heels, they said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar fell to 1.2202 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.2292 marks but rose to 90.61 yen from 90.30 yen.
